items.title: Hearing Aids Linked to 23% Lower Dementia Risk in Epilepsy
items.summary: Hearing aid use is associated with a 23% lower risk of dementia exclusively in adults with both epilepsy and hearing loss, likely due to the critical preservation of depleted cognitive reserve.
